detail.title: Robustness of Physical Records Across Independent Observers
detail.summary: Robustness of physical records emerges when environmental channels broadcast pointer states and structure information into redundant packets, with effective accessibility constrained by observer-specific thresholds.
detail.reason: Incorporating new evidence on observer-dependent accessibility and noisy-threshold aperture functions to update the robustness notebook.
